name: pcs-flash-sale-timer-upload
description: Weekly routine (Mondays 3:40 PM Pacific) that keeps Milwaukee flash sale deal timers correct on Toolup and Red Tool Store. Reads the Milwaukee Flash Sale Google Calendar, works out what goes live that week and which categories have freed up to be scheduled ahead, and writes countdown_date_start/end to each flash sale collection. Collection-level only - no product metafields are ever touched. Idempotent: compares the computed window against what each collection already holds and writes only on a difference, so re-runs are safe and a calendar date change is picked up automatically. Never overwrites a live window; a category frees up on the run after its sale ends. Windows are exactly 48 hours, 9 PM Pacific the day before Day 1 through 9 PM Pacific on Day 2, so the sale opens at midnight Eastern. Collections inherit their own on-sale + in-stock rules, so eligibility needs no per-product filtering and a window can be scheduled arbitrarily far ahead. Ships the category-to-tag map across both tag naming conventions, resolved collection IDs for both stores, and a documented workaround for the Calendar list_events tool being unavailable.
